subject: Seat-level invoice split and VAT handling for Elysian — format & delivery
messages:
From: Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@elysian-med.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: accounts@elysian-med.com
Date: 2028-07-11T08:12:00Z
Subject: Request: split invoices by BU & VAT IDs

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To finalize our accounting, Elysian needs the upcoming invoices split so each business unit receives a distinct subtotal line and VAT treatment for our three EMEA legal entities. Specifically: 

- One invoice file per month, but with separate line groups for: Elysian UK (VAT ID GB123456789), Elysian NL (VAT ID NL987654321), and Elysian DE (VAT ID DE112233445).
- Each group should show seats, unit price, subtotal (pre-VAT), VAT line (if applicable), and an entity-level total.
- We need cost_center and PO number in-line so our AP can auto-apply payments.
- Delivery: PDF accepted, but for automated ingestion we prefer an accompanying CSV or XML with the line-level metadata.

Can you send an example layout and confirm whether Redwood can do the VAT breakdown per entity (vs. us splitting on our side)? Also share the timeline for the July invoice — we need to trigger internal approvals.

Regards,
Alicia Perez
Head of Finance Operations
Elysian Medical

--
attachments: none referenced in this message
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@elysian-med.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-07-11T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices by BU & VAT IDs

Hi Alicia — thanks, this is straightforward to support.

Summary of what Redwood can provide out of the box:
- Single monthly invoice PDF that visually groups line items per legal entity with separate VAT lines and totals.
- Companion CSV (allocation_matrix.csv) with every line broken out by cost_center, entity_tax_id, seat_count, unit_price, line_id, PO_number and GL_code. This is what your AP can ingest.
- If you need machine-friendly e-invoices (XML/UBL), we can generate those as an add-on and deliver via SFTP or secure link.

I've attached a seat-level invoice template (seatwise_invoice_template.pdf) and an initial allocation matrix (allocation_matrix.csv) showing how we would tag lines. Please review the VAT ID mapping rows and confirm the PO field format you expect (e.g., PO-12345 vs 12345).

Proposed timeline:
- Today: confirm VAT IDs & PO format
- By 7/20: deliver test invoice (PDF + CSV) for your ingestion team to validate
- By 7/31: July production invoice with chosen delivery method

If this works, Jordan will provide the GL mapping and Priyom will confirm ledger tags during send.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
attachments: seatwise_invoice_template.pdf, allocation_matrix.csv
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-07-11T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices by BU & VAT IDs

Alicia — looping in the invoice structure you'll receive from the GL perspective. Right now we plan to emit one invoice file per month, with internal grouping and a per-entity subtotal. Suggested GL fields included in CSV:

- gl_account_code (your mapping)
- cost_center (Elysian BU code)
- entity_tax_id
- seat_count
- price_per_seat
- line_total_pre_vat
- vat_rate
- vat_amount
- line_total_incl_vat
- external_po_number

Question for AP: do you require the external PO at line-level or invoice-level? Line-level is preferred for automated matching but we can include both.

Also: if Elysian is going to perform a consolidated single-payment and then internally route, we can include a payment remittance file (.CSV) mapping payment buckets to entity totals to make reconciliation simpler.

Thanks,
Jordan
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-07-11T13:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices by BU & VAT IDs — ledger tags & VAT notes

Alicia — a couple of implementation notes from the ledger/invoicing side: 

1) Metadata fields: please confirm we should emit these exact column headers in the companion CSV: cost_center, entity_tax_id, seat_count, unit_price, po_number, invoice_line_id, gl_account. 
2) VAT handling: for cross-border seat provisioning within EU, we need to know whether Elysian intends to apply reverse-charge treatment for any entity pairs. If reverse charge applies we will set vat_rate=0 and populate vat_comment with reverse-charge note + EC VAT numbers.
3) Testing: we'll send one test invoice for July. Please run it through your ingestion and share any error rows.

I've attached a small VAT reference (vat_matrix.xlsx) that lays out typical EU parity cases — treat as advisory. Also note: include document-level fields document_id and invoice_uuid for programmatic reconciliation.

If AP confirms PO format and whether they accept a single payment with remittance file, we'll finalize the template today.

Best,
Priyom Das
Accounting Integrations, Redwood Inference

--
attachments: vat_matrix.xlsx
From: Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@elysian-med.com>

Cc: accounts@elysian-med.com
Date: 2028-07-11T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices by BU & VAT IDs

Vanessa, Jordan, Priyom — all good, thanks. Confirming: 

- PO format: please use PO-<numeric> (e.g., PO-210334) and include it at line-level and invoice-level.
- We accept a single payment from Elysian finance as long as you provide the remittance CSV that maps the gross payment to the three entity totals.
- For VAT: Elysian UK will handle reverse charge when applicable; for NL/DE please list VAT amounts normally. We'll validate specifics with our tax team and revert if a reverse-charge flag is required.
- Delivery: PDF + CSV is fine for now; we'll request XML if we automate further. For SFTP transfer please send connection details to accounts@elysian-med.com; otherwise a secure one-time link works.

Please proceed with the test invoice by 7/20. Include document_id and invoice_uuid in the CSV.

Thanks,
Alicia Perez
Head of Finance Operations
Elysian Medical
